extract_events_from_dataframe: extract Event objects from a pandas DataFrame with optional type filtering
extract_events_from_segments: extract Event objects from a list of Segment objects by collecting ns_events
extract_events_with_type_filter: extract Event objects filtered by specific event type names or classes
extract_events_from_dict: extract a single Event object from a dictionary using Event.from_dict
prepare_features_parallel: prepare feature objects in parallel using ThreadPoolExecutor for SLURM-based features
